notes: Now a believable hedgerow shrub. Polish left.

defects.text: Bare shrubs now spread, fork three levels deep and have low side twigs; reads as a winter shrub.
Leafy shrubs now leafy from low on the stems and fuller.
Leaf cards on twigs are uniform combs of the same width and droop; bare_a has one single spike well above the rest (about 1.9 m).
defects.fix: Vary leaf card width/length/droop per twig, cap the tallest stem at 0.85 of height.
